info.description:
# Nexus Tasks REST API

Nexus Tasks is a collaborative project and task management platform.
This document describes the full REST API surface of the backend service.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require an authenticated session established via the `/api/v2/auth/login`
or `/api/v2/auth/register` endpoints. Authentication state is maintained via an
HTTP-only session cookie (`nexus_user`). Alternatively, machine clients may
authenticate using an API Key passed in the `X-API-Key` request header.

## Base URL

All versioned resources are prefixed with `/api/v2`.

Uses an AI model to generate a detailed task description based on the provided title.
The response contains the generated markdown content as a string.

get.description: Returns all API keys belonging to the authenticated user. The raw tokens are never included.

Generates a new long-lived API key for machine-to-machine access. The raw token
is returned only once and must be stored securely by the caller.

201.description: API key created. The raw_token is shown only once.

400.description: Name is missing or request body is malformed.

delete.description:
Permanently invalidates the specified API key. Any requests authenticated with this
key will be rejected immediately after revocation.

parameters.description: UUID of the API key to revoke.
parameters.name: keyId

post.description: Validates credentials and sets an HTTP-only session cookie on success.
post.summary: Authenticate and obtain a session cookie

200.description: Login successful. Session cookie is set.

400.description: Validation error or malformed request body.

post.description: Clears the session cookie, effectively logging the user out.

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user based on the session cookie.

post.description: Creates a new user account and sets an authenticated session cookie.

400.description: Validation error or malformed request body.

get.description: Returns 200 if the API server and its critical dependencies (database) are healthy.

500.description: One or more dependencies are unhealthy.

get.description: Performs a lightweight ping against the primary database and returns 200 if reachable.
Returns 200 as long as the HTTP server process is running. Does not check external dependencies.
Returns all unread and uncleared notifications for the authenticated user, ordered by most recent first.

patch.description: Marks all of the authenticated user's notifications as cleared in a single operation.
Marks a notification as cleared, removing it from the user's active inbox view.
Sets the read flag on the specified notification. The notification remains visible until cleared.

get.description: Returns all tasks currently assigned to the authenticated user across all projects.

200.description: List of tasks assigned to the current user.

get.description:
Returns all time entries logged against the specified task, together with
an aggregated total and the task's estimated duration.
get.summary: List time entries for a task

post.description: Creates a manual time entry for the specified task without using the start/stop timer flow.

400.description: Validation error or invalid task ID.

post.description:
Cancels and discards the running timer without creating a time entry.
Any elapsed time is permanently lost.
Begins a new timer session for the specified task. Only one timer may be active per user at a time.

parameters.description: UUID of the task to time.
parameters.name: taskId

500.description: Internal server error (e.g. timer already running).

post.description:
Stops the currently running timer for the task and converts it to a time entry.
An optional description and/or duration override may be provided.

parameters.description: Optional stop parameters. Body may be omitted entirely.
parameters.name: body

200.description: Timer stopped and time entry created.

400.description: Invalid task ID or malformed body.

delete.description: Permanently removes the specified time entry. Only the user who created the entry may delete it.

get.description: Returns the currently running timer for the authenticated user, or null if no timer is active.
Returns all workspaces the authenticated user is a member of.

post.description: Creates a new workspace owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all users who are members of the given workspace.

post.description: Sends an invitation (or directly adds) a user to the workspace by email address.
post.summary: Invite a user to a workspace

400.description: Validation error or invalid workspace ID.

delete.description: Removes the specified user from the workspace. Only workspace admins may perform this action.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a workspace

parameters.description: UUID of the user to remove.
parameters.name: uid

get.description: Returns all projects belonging to the specified workspace that the authenticated user has access to.

post.description: Creates a new project within the specified workspace. Requires workspace admin privileges.

get.description: Returns the full details of a single project.

404.description: Project not found or not accessible.

patch.description: Partially updates project metadata. Supports archiving via `is_archived`.

400.description: Validation error or invalid project ID.

post.description:
Uses an AI model to generate a structured weekly progress report for the project,
based on tasks completed in the last 7 days and their associated comments.
Returns an error if no tasks were completed in that window.
post.summary: AI — Generate a weekly project report

400.description: No completed tasks found in the last 7 days.

500.description: AI service error or internal server error.

get.description:
Returns all members with access to the project, including both direct members and
those with access via team membership.

post.description: Directly assigns a user to the project with the specified role.
post.summary: Add a member to a project

400.description: Validation error or invalid path parameter.

delete.description: Revokes a user's direct membership in the project. Their access via team membership is not affected.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a project

parameters.description: UUID of the user to remove.
parameters.name: uid

get.description: Returns all tasks belonging to the specified project, with optional filtering by status or assignee.

parameters.description: Filter tasks by status (e.g. TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE).
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates a new task within the specified project. The authenticated user becomes the task author.

400.description: Validation error or invalid path parameter.

get.description: Returns the full details of a single task, including its assignee and author.

delete.description: Permanently removes a task and all its associated comments.

parameters.description: UUID of the task to delete.
parameters.name: taskId

patch.description: Partially updates the specified task. Only non-zero fields in the request body are applied.

400.description: Validation error or invalid task ID.

post.description:
Uses an AI model to produce a concise summary of all comments on the specified task.
Returns an error if the task has no comments.

400.description: No comments to summarize, or invalid path parameter.

500.description: AI service error or internal server error.

get.description: Returns all comments on the specified task, ordered by creation time ascending.

post.description: Adds a new comment to the specified task. Mentioned users will receive notifications.
post.summary: Post a comment on a task

400.description: Validation error or invalid task ID.

delete.description: Permanently removes a comment. Only the comment author may delete their own comment.

get.description: Returns all teams that have been associated with the specified project.

200.description: List of teams associated with the project.

post.description: Associates an existing workspace team with the project, granting all team members access.
post.summary: Add a team to a project

400.description: Validation error or invalid path parameter.

delete.description: Removes the team association from the project. Team members lose project access unless they have direct membership.
delete.summary: Remove a team from a project

get.description: Returns aggregated time tracking statistics for all tasks within the specified project.

Returns all time entries logged against tasks in the project. Supports filtering by
user, start date, and end date.

parameters.name: start_date

parameters.name: end_date

200.description: List of time entries with task context.

get.description: Returns all teams that belong to the specified workspace.

post.description: Creates a new team within the specified workspace. Requires workspace admin privileges.

get.description: Returns the details of a single team, including its associated projects.

delete.description: Permanently removes a team from the workspace. Requires workspace admin privileges.

patch.description: Updates the name and/or description of a team. Requires workspace admin privileges.

get.description: Returns all members of the specified team along with their roles.

post.description: Adds an existing workspace member to the specified team with an assigned role.
post.summary: Add a member to a team

400.description: Validation error or invalid path parameter.

delete.description: Removes the specified user from the team. Their workspace membership is not affected.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a team
